title: Thai-Style Roasted Chicken and Rice
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the best of Thai and Western cuisine. The roasted chicken is served with a side of savory rice and steamed vegetables.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together the light soy sauce, roasted rice, dried lemongrass, thai chili peppers, and white sugar (if using).
Place the chicken breast in a shallow baking dish and brush the soy sauce mixture evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is cooking, heat the kanom jeen sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the corn to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until it is tender.
Serve the roasted chicken with the steamed corn and a side of steamed vegetables.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as cilantro or basil, if desired.
